modules.name: Strait
modules.description: Stereo filter whose two sides can drift apart. LP, BP and HP at once, with SPREAD and DRIFT.

modules.name: Mult
modules.description: 2HP chance mult. One input, four outputs; each output has its own chance of passing every incoming hit. Polyphonic.

modules.name: Eddy
modules.description: A generative shift register: one loop of random voltage read at eight taps. DRIFT decides how often it changes as it comes round.

modules.name: Eddy Gates
modules.description: The gate expander for Eddy: eight gates, one per tap, high while the tap is above a threshold, or a trigger as it rises through it. Sits on Eddy's right.
